title: ELYSIUM: ACCELERATING HYPERLIQUID
summary_title: Elysium: Kinetiq's L2, launch plans and ecosystem
summary_description: Omnia on why Kinetic built a high-performance Layer 2 atop Hyperliquid, bringing Uniswap and tokenized equities to the ecosystem.
